name: biodino-edge
title: BioDINO-Edge: Biologically-Grounded Multi-Scale Vision Foundation Models for Trustworthy Few-Shot Plant Pathology on Resource-Constrained Hardware
description: Open Knowledge Foundation (OKF) specification package for trustworthy few-shot plant disease diagnosis using multi-scale self-supervised Vision Transformers (DINOv2), biological foundation models (BioCLIP), Regularized Fisher-LDA with Ledoit-Wolf Shrinkage, and dynamic INT8 edge CPU quantization.

resources.name: plantvillage-dataset
resources.description: 54,305 leaf images spanning 38 agricultural disease classes (30 Base classes, 8 Novel classes).

resources.name: biodino-edge-pipeline
resources.description: End-to-end Python pipeline for few-shot evaluation, Fisher-LDA fitting, multi-episode audit, and INT8 edge CPU benchmarking.

resources.name: biodino-edge-notebook
resources.description: Interactive Jupyter Notebook with step-by-step theory, execution, and confusion matrix visualizations.

resources.name: ieee-paper-manuscript
resources.description: Official IEEE conference format LaTeX manuscript with theoretical formulations and empirical evaluation tables.

resources.name: benchmark-results
resources.description: Comprehensive numerical benchmark metrics (97.34% peak accuracy, 94.95% 30-episode mean, INT8 latency profiling).

resources.name: algorithm-documentation
resources.description: Comprehensive execution and mathematical guide for BioDINO-Edge architecture.

resources.name: plant-pathology-domain-guide
resources.description: Essential agricultural plant pathology domain guide for AI researchers covering pathogens, visual clinical symptoms, and defense strategies against pathology reviewers.

resources.name: mathematics-foundation-guide
resources.description: Comprehensive 1,150+ lines pedagogical mathematical foundation guide explaining every concept from middle school geometry and calculus up to Ledoit-Wolf regularized Fisher-LDA.
